description: Peek at the structure of a local data file: detect format, list sheet names (for .xlsx), extract headers, infer column types, and return the first few rows. Use this before deciding how to map data into WaterfallBridge format. GATE: on a multi-sheet workbook called WITHOUT a `sheet`, this returns { success:false, blocked:true, sheets:[…] } — ask the user which worksheet to use, then re-call with that `sheet` name (do NOT guess the tab).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to inspect.

preview_rows.description: Number of preview rows to return (default 20, max 200).

sheet.description: Worksheet name (for .xlsx). Defaults to the first non-empty sheet.

name: inspect_local_file
